snippet.title: Cordy ios iphone gameplay
snippet.description:
Описание
• TOP 10 BEST GAMES - The New York Times.

• #1 APP in the United States, Canada, China, Germany, France, Spain and many more!

• BEST APPS ON APP STORE. Featured "New & Noteworthy", "Staff Favorite", "Great Platformer", and "App of the Week" by Apple in numerous countries.

CORDY is the little robot with the big job - to power up his world! Help Cordy run, jump, push, pull, lift, throw, bounce, swing, and hover in this beautiful console-quality 3D puzzle platform game. Download now, and get ready to harness the power of pure fun! "One of mobile gaming's most accomplished platformers." -IGN. "gorgeous... compelling" -Pocket Gamer & The Guardian.

• HOURS OF GAMEPLAY. The full game is packed with many more levels that increase in length, with fast-paced fun and ramped difficulty! "Tons of Replay Value" -Touch Arcade.

• PLAY FREE BEFORE YOU BUY. Try 4 free awesome levels so you can be sure you like the game. You can buy the full game from within using In-App Billing. This feature can be disabled using Restrictions in your iOS device's Settings menu.

• WANT MORE GAMES LIKE THIS? Play CORDY SKY and SLEEPY JACK! Top 10 Best Games of Year: "Adorable Psychonauts-esque presentation and solid gameplay...that is also tight and arcadey" -Pocket Gamer. BEST APP OF THE WEEK: "It's the sort of happiness-inducing experience that you want to share with everyone." -Kotaku

• 'LIKE' SilverTree at facebook.com/TheMeedj & follow SilverTree on Twitter @silvertreemedia

• PLAYERS, WE READ EVERY E-MAIL. We're a small company, but we reply to every support request. Let us try to help at cordysupport@silvertreemedia.com and we will do our best to help in any way!
